description: Expand the AssistantGuardrail CfnGuardrail in infra/lib/security-data-stack.ts to exercise the full feature surface supported by the INSTALLED aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0 (verified against infra/node_modules/aws-cdk-lib/aws-bedrock/lib/bedrock.generated.d.ts). Pure infra/TypeScript change; independent of FEAT-002 (no shared files). Keep the published CfnGuardrailVersion wiring and the guardrailId/guardrailVersion public-readonly cross-stack contract unchanged — a new published guardrail version on redeploy is expected and acceptable.
steps: Edit the AssistantGuardrail CfnGuardrail in infra/lib/security-data-stack.ts. contentPolicyConfig.filtersConfig: HATE, VIOLENCE, INSULTS, MISCONDUCT, SEXUAL each { inputStrength: 'HIGH', outputStrength: 'HIGH' }, PLUS { type: 'PROMPT_ATTACK', inputStrength: 'HIGH', outputStrength: 'NONE' } (Bedrock rule: PROMPT_ATTACK is input-filtering only). Do NOT add contentPolicyConfig.tierConfig — the installed ContentPolicyConfigProperty has ONLY filtersConfig.
Add wordPolicyConfig: managedWordListsConfig: [{ type: 'PROFANITY' }] and wordsConfig: [{ text: 'competitorcafe' }, { text: 'freecoffeehack' }, { text: 'voucherabuse' }].

Expand sensitiveInformationPolicyConfig.piiEntitiesConfig: KEEP the existing US_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUMBER (ANONYMIZE), US_SOCIAL_SECURITY_NUMBER (ANONYMIZE), EMAIL (ANONYMIZE). ADD BLOCK for CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER, CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_CVV, PIN, PASSWORD, AWS_ACCESS_KEY, AWS_SECRET_KEY. ADD ANONYMIZE for CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_EXPIRY, PHONE, ADDRESS, NAME, US_BANK_ROUTING_NUMBER, AGE, USERNAME. All identifiers are valid Bedrock GuardrailPiiEntityType values present in the installed PiiEntityConfig docs.

Add sensitiveInformationPolicyConfig.regexesConfig: [{ name: 'loyalty-card', description: 'Demo loyalty-card id pattern', pattern: 'LOYALTY-[0-9]{8}', action: 'ANONYMIZE' }] (RegexConfigProperty supports name/description/pattern/action).

Expand topicPolicyConfig.topicsConfig: KEEP legal-advice (DENY, with its definition+examples). ADD 'medical-advice' and 'financial-investment-advice' as DENY topics, each with a definition and 2 examples.
Add contextualGroundingPolicyConfig.filtersConfig: [{ type: 'GROUNDING', threshold: 0.7 }, { type: 'RELEVANCE', threshold: 0.7 }] (ContextualGroundingPolicyConfigProperty IS supported in 2.160.0).
Optionally refine blockedInputMessaging / blockedOutputsMessaging wording; keep both non-empty. Update the stack/guardrail description comment to reflect the broader config.

Extend the existing 'Bedrock Guardrail ...' assertion in infra/test/template.test.ts using Match.arrayWith/Match.objectLike to additionally assert: PROMPT_ATTACK with OutputStrength 'NONE'; WordPolicyConfig with the PROFANITY managed list; at least one BLOCK PII entity (e.g. CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER with Action 'BLOCK'); RegexesConfig with the loyalty pattern; the medical-advice DENY topic; and ContextualGroundingPolicyConfig with a GROUNDING filter. Do NOT modify the pre-existing failing 'raw Bedrock invocation-logging config' check.

Write /home/ubuntu/apcr-dva/demo/session5-secure-assistant/.agents/tasks/verification.md noting: contentPolicyConfig.tierConfig is NOT present in aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0 ContentPolicyConfigProperty and was intentionally skipped; contextualGroundingPolicyConfig IS supported and was included; and the pre-existing 'raw Bedrock invocation-logging config' template assertion fails on baseline and was deliberately left unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: cd infra && npx tsc --noEmit compiles with no errors (an unsupported property key would fail here).

CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=875692608981 JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 npx cdk synth SecureAssistantSecurityData synthesizes without error and the AWS::Bedrock::Guardrail resource contains all six content filters (with PROMPT_ATTACK OutputStrength NONE), the word policy (PROFANITY + custom words), the expanded PII entities + loyalty regex, three DENY topics, and the contextual-grounding filters.
cd infra && npm test passes every assertion EXCEPT the single pre-existing 'raw Bedrock invocation-logging config' failure (total failures stay exactly 1); the extended Guardrail assertion passes.
The CfnGuardrailVersion resource and the guardrailId/guardrailVersion public readonly members are unchanged (still exactly one AWS::Bedrock::GuardrailVersion).
.agents/tasks/verification.md exists and documents the tierConfig skip and the known-failing invocation-logging test.
verification: cd /home/ubuntu/apcr-dva/demo/session5-secure-assistant/infra && CDK_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT=875692608981 JSII_SILENCE_WARNING_UNTESTED_NODE_VERSION=1 npx cdk synth SecureAssistantSecurityData >/dev/null
cd /home/ubuntu/apcr-dva/demo/session5-secure-assistant/infra && npm test   # expect exactly the 1 known 'raw Bedrock invocation-logging config' failure, nothing else
findings: Done. Expanded AssistantGuardrail in infra/lib/security-data-stack.ts with all six content filters (HATE/VIOLENCE/INSULTS/MISCONDUCT/SEXUAL HIGH + PROMPT_ATTACK input-only HIGH/NONE), wordPolicyConfig (PROFANITY managed list + 3 custom words), expanded PII (BLOCK: CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER/CVV/PIN/PASSWORD/AWS_ACCESS_KEY/AWS_SECRET_KEY; ANONYMIZE: existing + CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_EXPIRY/PHONE/ADDRESS/NAME/US_BANK_ROUTING_NUMBER/AGE/USERNAME), loyalty-card regex (LOYALTY-[0-9]{8} ANONYMIZE), three DENY topics (legal/medical/financial-investment advice), and contextualGroundingPolicyConfig (GROUNDING + RELEVANCE @0.7). contentPolicyConfig.tierConfig intentionally omitted (absent from ContentPolicyConfigProperty in aws-cdk-lib 2.160.0 — only filtersConfig exists; adding it would break tsc). CfnGuardrailVersion wiring and guardrailId/guardrailVersion contract unchanged (GuardrailVersion count still 1). Extended the template.test.ts Guardrail assertion. VERIFIED: tsc --noEmit clean; cdk synth SecureAssistantSecurityData clean; npm test = exactly 1 failure (the pre-existing out-of-scope 'raw Bedrock invocation-logging config' check, left untouched), no other regressions. TEST GOTCHA for later editors: Match.arrayWith matches patterns POSITIONALLY in array order, so PII patterns must be listed in the order they appear in the synthesized array (BLOCK CREDIT_DEBIT_CARD_NUMBER first, then ANONYMIZE entities); nested policy objects wrapped in Match.objectLike. verification.md written at .agents/tasks/verification.md. NOTE: a redeploy will publish a new guardrail version (expected/acceptable per feature spec).
